summary: Runtime dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub ref
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever bytes that user's repository HEAD serves at install time and runs any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched source. The resolution target is a personal GitHub account unrelated to the upstream libsignal project and whose owner is not the npm publisher of this package, so control of the installed code sits with that third-party account rather than with this package's maintainer or the libsignal project. The dependency is pulled in on every default install of raiden-baileys@2.2.5.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
